units.source_text: 据佛教中说：天人果报尽时，暂堕三恶道，即地狱道、饿鬼道、畜生道。

en.t: According to Buddhist teaching, when heavenly beings exhaust the rewards of their karma, they temporarily fall into the three evil realms: the realm of hell, the realm of hungry ghosts, and the realm of animals.
After passing through this suffering, they are born again in the heavenly realm.
